Name: Welcome Gift From Harvey
Author: scarboy17
Description:
Harvey has sent the new farmer in town a welcome gift. Kindly gifting you 3 energy tonics to help you explore the valley without no worries. You will receive the mail on the 2nd day of spring year 1. 

In the newest update Mail Framework Mod is no longer needed and instead just need Content Patcher. You are also able to customize the season, Day of delivery and how much you will receive. Choosing the day will schedule your delivery for the next day. 

Please delete the old files as the file name has been changed slighly.

[size=4][u]Installation:[/u][/size]
[list]
[*]Download and Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download and Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ to /Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Download and Install this mod to /Stardew Valley/Mods.
[/list]
